reels.hook: Everyone in LA claims their listing is private—until you step into the backyard and see three neighbors staring down at your pool.
reels.caption:
Everyone in LA claims their listing is private—until you step into the backyard and see three neighbors staring down at your pool.

5200 Armida Dr is the exception. Tucked at the top of a long driveway off a cul-de-sac, this property offers over a half-acre of absolute, untouchable seclusion South of the Boulevard. 🌴

This isn’t just a remodel; it’s a masterclass in scale and execution. They didn’t just update the kitchen—they brought in massive porcelain slabs, premium Thermador appliances, and real wood custom cabinetry. They kept the soul of the home with a classic wood-burning fireplace and created a seamless flow straight out to your private pool and outdoor kitchen.

But here is why smart money is looking at this property: The footprint. On top of the flawless 3,600 sq ft main house, you get a brand-new, fully detached 600 sq ft ADU in the back.

Whether you need space for extended family, a private creative studio, or you want to generate premium rental income, this setup gives you total flexibility without compromising an inch of luxury.

This is what zero-compromise living looks like.

📍 5200 Armida Dr, Woodland Hills, CA 91364
🏡 Main House: 4 Beds | 3 Baths (~3,600 Sq Ft)
